text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Nn… I'm sorry, I was in a… meeting. An 
intellectual evil… kind of situation.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes… Last night, the beverage that 
Bakushins one's thoughts… Coffee, I drank 
too much of it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Stay sharp, keep that drowsiness away!" 
the label said… but I didn't expect it to 
go this far…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yaaaawn～… Trainer, please do be careful 
around coffee.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Only one cup, and it has this effect… 
…I'll… only get through half of the day 
today.

Perhaps because of her overly straight- 
laced nature, Sakura Bakushin O was unable 
to sleep well after just one cup of 
coffee…
